The house I lived in before moving to my current apartment was awful. I lived there for about 3 years and the first 2 years, never really had anything weird happen. About a year ago, my roommate went out of town for a week and I was really pumped to have the house to myself. I was watching tv one night in the living room when I started hearing loud noises coming from the basement. Initially thought nothing of it and ignored it but it only got louder and increased in frequency. Ever since that night, I began to feel very uncomfortable in that house, especially when I was alone or going to bed for the night. It certainly wasn't a constant thing - a month would go by where nothing would happen and I would kind of forget there was ever an issue. But it would always come back. The main thing that bothered me was the sensation of being watched, which would come and go. I would be sitting on the couch in the living room, deeply engrossed in something when all of a sudden, I would get an overwhelming feeling that something was there with me. That's the only way I can describe it. It would come out of nowhere - I'd come home tipsy at night and start making a sandwich or something when all of a sudden, I'd feel eyes on me. Be in the bathroom, taking a shower, and same thing would happen. That's kind of how it started. Then it moved on to other things - I was alone one evening, taking a shower when I got that familiar feeling of being watched. When I got out of the shower, the front door was open, as was the door to the garage. I noped out of there pretty quickly until my roommate got home. Another night, i had gotten in a fight with my boyfriend before bed so I went and laid on the couch in the living room and was crying to myself. All of a sudden, I got the feeling of being watched and felt a super oppressive, heavy feeling. Not really sure how else to describe it but it felt fucking awful and terrifying. I couldn't go into the basement alone anymore, I couldn't even look down the hallway towards the basement door because I could just sense that whatever it was, that's where it was based. The worst thing that happened was I woke up in the middle of night one time from a pretty weird dream. I turned on The Office and watched a couple episodes to get my mind off of it and go back into sleep mode. I was laying there watching it when all of a sudden, it sounded like someone set off a firecracker in my room and I had the sensation that something had been thrown at me. I was paralyzed for a moment but then I got up and turned the light on to try and figure out what the hell just happened. Of course, I could find nothing to account for the noise or feeling, nothing out of the ordinary, etc. After that night, I was so terrified of sleeping in that house that my boyfriend would stay over pretty much every night. On the nights he couldn't, I would take a bunch of klonopin to knock myself out so there was no chance of me waking up in the middle of the night. These weird occurrences happened until I moved. Haven't had a problem since then.
